name: software_pegasus
description: Pegasus WMS workflows (e.g. montage-workflow-v3) on HPC without an HTCondor pool: planning-only userspace Condor (never started), Pegasus 5.0.7 binary, pegasus-mpi-cluster (PMC) rebuilt against the system MPI, sites.yml + pegasus.properties for PMC-only code generation, pegasus-plan --conf, PMC launched under flux run with a wrapper exporting LD_LIBRARY_PATH and dftracer env, rank sizing, dftracer trace verification. Load for any Pegasus workflow work, or on: 'libmpichcxx.so.10 => not found'; successive 'cannot open shared object file' (libmpi_cray.so.12, libpmi.so.0, libpals.so.0); 'File Server not specified for shared-scratch filesystem'; 'FileNotFoundException: .../run0001 (Is a directory)' at MPIExec.generatePMCInputFile; "ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'six.moves'"; 'ABORT: failure.cpp(22): Invalid DAG record: MAXJOBS'; stage_in tasks hang then exit 256; PMC silent after 'Running PMC cluster with DAG'.
